title: Duane Arnold (NextEra restart): Duane Arnold Energy Center - Fixed Fee Caps for Ongoing Restart Licensing Actions [['E-Mail', 'Letter']]

documents.text:
From:            Justin Poole
To:              ext_ROBERT_MURRELL; Davis, James
Cc:              Ilka Berrios; Brent Ballard
Subject:         RE: Duane Arnold Energy Center - Fixed Fee Caps for Ongoing Licensing Actions
Date:            Tuesday, September 29, 2026 11:16:46 AM



Bob/Mike,

In accordance with 10 CFR 170.33, which becomes effective on October 1, 2026, this communication
establishes the fixed cap on service fees (fixed fee cap) for NextEra Energy Duane Arnold, LLC for the
Duane Arnold Energy Center licensing actions listed in the table below. The table lists the fixed fee
caps for the NRC’s review of ongoing licensing actions that have been accepted for review that will be
within the scope of 10 CFR 170.33. Fixed fee caps for other licensing actions, such as those currently
under acceptance review, will be communicated by separate correspondence. The NRC considered
various factors when establishing these fixed fee caps, such as the quality and complexity of the
application, technology type, and any pre-application engagement. The Professional Hourly Rate
established at 10 CFR 170.20(a) applies to these licensing actions.

Application Date     Acceptance            EPID                                                  Fixed Fee
(ADAMS               Date                                                                        Cap
Accession No.)
 1/23/2025            2/28/2025             L-2025-LLE-0004, Exemption to 50.82(a)(2) to $123,000.00
(ML25023A270)                              Support Restart
 11/10/2025          3/25/2026             L-2025-LNE-0009, Restart Environmental        $1,289,000.00
(ML25315A003)                              Review
11/20/2025           12/15/2025            L-2025-LLA-0180, License Amendment to         $207,000.00
(ML25324A300)                              Restore Operating License and Technical
                                           Specifications
 12/17/2025           1/30/2026             L-2025-LLA-0205, LAR to Revise Security Plan $123,000.00
(ML25363A083)                              to Support Restart
 1/30/2026            3/9/2026              L-2026-LLA-0019, License Amendment to        $226,000.00
(ML26033A048)                              Restore Emergency Plan to Support Potential
                                           Restart

The fixed fee cap represents the maximum amount that the NRC may charge for service fees for each
of the requested licensing actions following acceptance of the complete application. The fixed fee cap
will not be increased except in instances of applicant failure, as defined in 10 CFR 170.3. If applicant
failure occurs, the NRC will notify [LICENSEE] in writing of the new fixed fee cap, which will be set at
the lowest practicable amount determined by the NRC to account for the applicant failure and
complete the review.

For each licensing action, the NRC will track service fees against the fixed fee cap beginning on the
acceptance date listed above.  
 Disputes associated with a fixed fee cap must be submitted in accordance with 10 CFR 15.31 and
170.33(f) and NRC Form 529 procedures. If you have any questions, please contact me.

Justin C. Poole
Sr. Project Manager
Palisades, Crane, Duane Arnold Restart
NRR/DLP-1/ORLB 3
U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission
